> [!NOTE]
> The method is in preview (`DDD-dec-74`). A field report is the most valuable thing you can send:
> it is how a step moves from projected to reported, or back to open. A report where the step
> failed is worth exactly as much as one where it held.
>
> Never include customer-identifying material. Describe the system by its kind, not its owner.

## The step, and its register when you ran it

<!-- Which step card, at which release. Its register (Ruled, [PROPOSED], [OPEN]) is on the card. -->

## The system you ran it on

<!-- Its kind and size, not its name. What was declared as ground before the step ran. -->

## What the step produced

<!-- The artefact out. Attach it, or paste it, if you can share it. -->

## Value made visible

<!-- What could you now see, do, or refuse that you could not before? "Nothing" is a valid answer. -->

## Where it bent

<!-- An act with no address, a decision that anchored nowhere, a cost the card did not name,
     an exit check that would not close. Quote the card's line that failed. -->
